scripts.build: pkg . --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/KluffPrintAgent.exe && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('dist/KluffPrintAgent.exe');b.writeUInt16LE(2,b.readUInt32LE(0x3C)+92);fs.writeFileSync('dist/KluffPrintAgent.exe',b);fs.copyFileSync('dist/KluffPrintAgent.exe','KluffPrintAgent.exe');console.log('Build complete: Pure GUI mode (0 black console window)');"
